What is a Foreign Patient Registration Clinic?
해외 환자에게 합법적이고 안전한 의료 서비스를 제공합니다.

Mind One Dental Clinic is an official 'Foreign Patient Attracting Institution' that has met the strict standards set by the Ministry of Health and Welfare to provide legal and safe medical services to international patients. To achieve this, Mind One Dental Clinic has passed rigorous evaluations across various criteria, including the expertise of our medical staff, a thorough patient safety management system, the availability of interpretation and multilingual counseling for smooth communication, and the highest standard of medical facilities and equipment.

 Certificate for International patient

Honest Care with Zero Overtreatment

Prioritizing Your Natural Teeth

과잉진료 없는 정직한 진료 

자연 치아 보존 최우선 

Dental treatments can be expensive and time-consuming. We alleviate this concern by strictly following a "no overtreatment" policy, recommending only the essential procedures you truly need based on your specific condition. 

Making the right treatment decision from the beginning is crucial for your dental health. Our primary goal is to always protect and preserve your natural teeth whenever possible, rather than opting for unnecessary procedures.

···   FAQ   ···

Q1.

Is Mind One Dental Clinic authorized to treat international patients? 

Yes, Mind One Dental Clinic is officially registered by the Gwangju Metropolitan City of Korea as a "Foreign Patient Registration Clinic." This means we are legally authorized by the Korean government to safely provide trusted healthcare services to foreign visitors.

Q2.

How does the clinic ensure a high standard of care for foreign visitors?

We meet all the strict government standards required for treating international patients. This includes having highly qualified dental professionals, advanced equipment, robust patient safety systems, and dedicated multilingual support.

Q3.

What specific services are provided to make the process easier for international patients?

We offer a range of convenient services designed for our global patients, including online pre-consultations and booking, treatments using advanced 3D scanning and digital dental equipment, and detailed post-treatment guidance in multiple languages.


Q4.

Do you have staff available who can speak foreign languages? 

Yes, Mind One Dental Clinic has professional foreign language interpretation staff. They are dedicated to assisting our international patients and ensuring clear, accurate communication so you can receive comfortable care without any language barriers.
